Container.Name: StavenMediaManager
Container.Overview:
Local media management tool for Unraid.
Enumerates incoming directories by media type (movies, audiobooks, music, games, etc.), detects RAR archives, and extracts them with real-time async progress tracking. All data is stored in a single SQLite file inside the appdata volume — no separate database container required.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web interface listens on.

Config.Name: Appdata (Config & Database)
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database and application settings. Back this up to preserve job history.

Config.Name: Incoming Directory
Config.Description: Parent directory whose subdirectories are treated as media categories (e.g. /mnt/user/media-files/temp/incoming contains Movies/, Audiobooks/, Music/). Read-write so extracted files can be placed in-place.

Config.Name: TMDb API Key
Config.Description: Free API key from https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api — required for IMDB movie matching. Leave blank to disable the feature.

Config.Name: Media Library
Config.Description: Destination media library root. Workflow actions will move processed content here (e.g. movies land in {Media Library}/movies/{Title (Year)}/).

Config.Name: rTorrent XMLRPC URL
Config.Description: XMLRPC endpoint for your rTorrent instance, e.g. https://username.servername.usbx.me/RPC2

Config.Name: rTorrent Username
Config.Description: HTTP Basic Auth username for the XMLRPC endpoint.

Config.Name: rTorrent Password
Config.Description: HTTP Basic Auth password for the XMLRPC endpoint.

Config.Name: rTorrent Import Tag
Config.Description: ruTorrent label to watch for importing (e.g. 'import'). After download the label is renamed to '{tag}-imported'.

Config.Name: rTorrent Lookback Hours
Config.Description: How many hours back to check for completed torrents.

Config.Name: Seedbox SSH Host
Config.Description: SSH hostname for file download, e.g. servername.usbx.me

Config.Name: Seedbox SSH User
Config.Description: SSH username (usually the same as your rTorrent username).

Config.Name: Seedbox SSH Password
Config.Description: SSH password. Leave blank if using an SSH key instead.

Config.Name: Seedbox SSH Key Path
Config.Description: Path inside the container to your SSH private key. Mount the key file as a volume at this path.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Plex server, e.g. http://192.168.1.x:32400 — used to trigger a library refresh after a move. Leave blank to disable.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Your Plex authentication token (X-Plex-Token). Find it at https://support.plex.tv/articles/204059436
